# Voltecharged

> Voltecharged sells small kitchen appliances built for people short on counter
> space. The flagship is the Voltecharged portable blender: 200W of ice-crushing
> power, USB-C rechargeable, a 400ml cup — blend and drink from the same
> container, anywhere. The range also covers coffee and soft-serve machines.

## Shop

- [Portable blender](https://voltecharged.com/blender.html): 200W ice-crushing
  portable blender, USB-C rechargeable, 400ml.
- [Coffee](https://voltecharged.com/coffee.html): coffee makers and grinders.
- [Soft serve](https://voltecharged.com/soft-serve.html): countertop soft-serve machines.
- [Home](https://voltecharged.com/): the full storefront.
